run_perf_process: run a perf benchmark binary for a given function name and data size
run_benchmark: run a benchmark comparing boost.compute against thrust, bolt, tbb, and stl
Report_add_sample: add a size and time sample to a named benchmark report
Report_display: display benchmark report results as size and time pairs to stdout
Report_plot_time: plot a log-log chart of execution time versus data size for a benchmark
